verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents a Skills feature and MCP/tool integrations (librechat-docs-32, librechat-docs-7, librechat-docs-24) but there is no evidence of a registry security process — no scanning/moderation pipeline for submitted skills, no provenance/signing scheme, and no documented incident response for malicious submissions. missing for 10: security scanning or vetting of skills/plugins, provenance/signing mechanism, documented process for handling malicious submissions.
